title: Bug Reproduction
searchIntent: grok bot to reproduce a bug
intro: Reproducing a reported bug is the least popular part of engineering and one of the better fits for an agent, because the work is mechanical: read the report, get the environment into the described state, confirm whether the thing happens, write down exactly what you did. The value is not cleverness, it is patience — a bot will try the fourteenth permutation without resenting it. What separates a useful bot here from a demo is whether it can actually drive the software, which usually means a browser session and real credentials. That is also the reason to be careful: a bot with a logged-in session against a production account can do more than reproduce a bug. Prefer ones that run against a staging environment, and read what access the template asks for before you install it.
